in_marathi.name: Lakhindra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Fort
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lakhindra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Lakhindra is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound name, composed of two words: 'Laksha' and 'Hindra'. 'Laksha' means 'fort' or 'goal', and 'Hindra' means 'destroyer' or 'slayer'. Thus, Lakhindra can be interpreted as the 'Lord of Fort' or the 'Slayer of Forts'. This name is often associated with the Hindu god Indra, who is the deity of rain, thunder, and the sky.
